reviewer.role: Independent pass over design documents and prepared inputs; not independent human review or an independent statistical rater
reviewer.prior_exposure: Reviewer previously audited old-run failures and source material. No new v494 pilot responses were read for this review.

scope.reviewed: Current frozen v4.9.4 pilot design, five prepared D0 input files, latest available v4.9.3 manuscript file, fixed v4.9.2 r2 evaluation and related preparation provenance.
scope.not_reviewed: No new pilot output, semantic coding result, current run completion or performance was inspected. No claim is made that F0 execution followed its intended design merely because its contract is consistent.
scope.cpu_scope: Lightweight Node filesystem reads, JSON comparisons and small-file hashes only; no tests, rendering or native shell commands.

research_question.manuscript_title: 공통 생성형 AI의 기관별 공개 투자판단 반영
research_question.question: 공통 운용 과제와 동일한 시장상황에서 AI는 기관별 공개 산업판단을 근거 있는 배분 제안에 어떻게 반영하며, 자료의 초안 전후 제공에 따라 그 연결이 어떻게 달라지는가?
research_question.observable_chain: Public source meaning -> stated adoption/qualification/departure -> supporting/competing visible evidence -> actual allocation or own draft-to-final change
research_question.topic_connection: The design examines institutional public-evidence use in a common AI allocation workflow. Arithmetic and citation checks are prerequisites and diagnostics within that question; they must not replace it with a JSON-compliance benchmark or a trading-performance study.

authority_and_versions.current_control: research/recovery_20261025/pilot_freeze.json binds the current prompt, runtime, preparation and r2 evaluation for pilot only.
authority_and_versions.inherited_design: The v4.9.1 plan supplies the original E/L question and common task; explicitly superseded counts, control design and reviewer policy must be read through r2 and the current freeze.
authority_and_versions.manuscript_asof: The v493 filename contains a manuscript whose version field says protocol 4.9.2 and whose status table is dated October 19. It is a historical snapshot, not current run evidence.

estimand_and_denominators.unit: One prespecified document/workflow case under one market snapshot; first F0 raw response is the primary endpoint. D0 and sector rows are dependent components.
estimand_and_denominators.estimand: Early source exposure plus the resulting own draft/history versus first source exposure during final review, conditional on the same final source refresh and common evidence. This is a descriptive workflow contrast, not a separately identified timing, memory, exposure-count or psychological anchoring effect.
estimand_and_denominators.preservation: Retain failed, incomplete and unattempted planned cells in the five-case denominator. Also report actual attempts, completion, readability, full vectors, valid raw vectors, assessable claims and eligible comparisons separately.

conditions.D0: Assigned institutional packet plus common inputs
conditions.F0: Same assigned packet refreshed, full own D0 and actual calculator feedback retained

conditions.D0: Common inputs only; no institutional identity, ratings or packet
conditions.F0: Assigned institutional packet first supplied, full own D0 and actual calculator feedback retained
Still common inputs only, with full own D0 and actual feedback; a separate generated trajectory

conditions_and_contrasts.within_case: Use each case’s own D0/F0; compare stated revision with its actual delta. Do not substitute another case’s draft or an L draft for the matched-stage C final.
between_cases: Within-source E versus L, conditional on the procedural confounding described above.
Between-source comparison under the same arm, interpreted with original source-contrast evidence.
Each source-conditioned F0 versus the single matched-stage C F0, with common task and stage count held fixed.
Difference between the E and L between-source distances requires four valid source-conditioned finals; it is descriptive, not causal difference-in-differences.
limitations: Equal F0 block order does not mean equal absolute token positions or equal histories.
L and C have identical initial messages but separate generation requirements. Repetition of the same input/seed is not an independent-rater or population-replication design.
Fixed nonrandomized case order leaves possible time/environment effects; runtime metadata can describe them but cannot randomize them away.
C lacks an institutional outlook packet, not all institution-origin numerical data or model pretraining knowledge.

allocation_error_and_infrastructure_hand.ordinary_output_error: A readable draft that otherwise clears the declared progression gate is not censored merely for a budget error or unsupported citation/label. Preserve these as observed model failures; no retry, silent normalization, clipping, imputation, benchmark replacement or success-driven case selection.
allocation_error_and_infrastructure_hand.progression_gate: Transport/termination, full JSON/schema and complete finite-vector failures can prevent dependent F0. A token-limit termination is distinct from a normal completion. Instrument-integrity failures are separately reported and can halt further execution.
allocation_error_and_infrastructure_hand.analysis_eligibility: Valid-portfolio distances require complete finite nonnegative raw vectors satisfying the frozen numerical budget check. Preserve sums and residuals. A full JSON vector can be arithmetically analysable even if response termination or explanation structure was problematic, without relabeling the response as successful.
allocation_error_and_infrastructure_hand.invalid_vector_diagnostics: Explicit raw component differences may diagnose a false increase/decrease claim even when a valid-portfolio distance is unavailable. Label them as raw-number diagnostics, not repaired feasible portfolios.
allocation_error_and_infrastructure_hand.missingness: Null plus reason for an invalid/missing comparison; never zero distance. Infrastructure interruption does not establish that the model ignored institutional evidence.
allocation_error_and_infrastructure_hand.tolerance: The 1e-6 budget tolerance is an inherited engineering convention, not an investment or semantic threshold. Preserve the frozen eligibility implementation and separately label exact-decimal diagnostics; do not silently switch criteria after results.

source_citation_and_weight_mapping.citation: Allowed-ID membership and correct sector/source labels are separate from substantive claim support. A correct ID alone does not establish entailment; unsupported attribution remains assessable in C and L D0 although source fidelity is otherwise not applicable.
source_citation_and_weight_mapping.interpretation: Retain original rating vocabulary, universe, date, missing reasons and uncertainty. Fidelity Overweight is not identical to UBS Attractive. No source publishes the required full eleven-sector target allocation.
source_citation_and_weight_mapping.mapping: Compare explicit baseline-relative claims with w_i minus the stated reference, and explicit revision claims with the same case’s F0 minus D0. Do not invent a benchmark the response never specified or assume Fidelity’s broad-market universe exactly equals the task’s S&P 500 anchor.
source_citation_and_weight_mapping.meaningful_departure: A supported explicit departure can preserve accurate interpretation. Similar weights can have different supported reasons; different weights can have unsupported reasons.
source_citation_and_weight_mapping.visibility: Judge output using evidence supplied to that stage. Evaluator-only original-source facts belong to a separate packet-fidelity audit and cannot become hidden requirements for the model.
source_citation_and_weight_mapping.topic_priority: Report at least one traceable evidence-to-choice account for every assessed sector/claim where available; missing or unassessable links remain explicit. Do not reduce the final report to weight sums and citation-ID counts.

AI_review_limits.masking: Planned review copies remove arm labels, execution order and preferred hypothesis, while retaining required evidence. Content/source absence can reveal condition; this is incomplete masking, not full blinding.
AI_review_limits.actual_reviewer_disclosure: Record the actual reviewer/model identity and exposed version, role, evidence/input hashes and prior exposure. Codex and same-family subagents are not independent humans or independent statistical raters.
AI_review_limits.three_checks: Repeated error/consistency/topic checks are process checks. They do not yield three independent measurements or a majority-vote truth.
AI_review_limits.semantic_status: Task-specific AI coding is unvalidated; arithmetic tests do not validate semantics. Preserve disagreements, unresolved cases and assessable-claim coverage; no composite score or post-hoc success threshold.
AI_review_limits.bias_claim: Evidence locators and individual-first review support auditability. Their local bias-reduction effectiveness has not been measured.
AI_review_limits.not_certified_here: This design-only review does not certify that outcome review bundles are masked or that future reviewers adhered to the planned procedure.

issues.finding: The inherited plan still states four cases/eight calls and older human-review prerequisites. Current r2 and the v494 freeze specify five cases/ten calls and user-delegated AI review; main remains disabled.
issues.constraint: Cite current controlling references and disclose supersession. Do not combine the old counts with current C, fabricate human approval, or treat this discrepancy as permission to launch main.

issues.finding: The hash-bound prompt/runtime retain candidate-stage status fields, while the later enclosing freeze declares the pilot frozen.
issues.constraint: Identify freeze authority by path/hash and timestamp. Do not mutate frozen payloads to cosmetically change status, and do not infer current readiness from those fields alone.

issues.finding: The manuscript’s October 19 progress statements and output-unread declaration describe the older run/time. The October 25 development freeze explicitly acknowledges old outputs were inspected.
issues.constraint: Keep the historical manuscript unchanged here. A later report must distinguish old-run interruption, post-output v494 prompt clarification and the new run; do not pool them as identical prespecified replications or claim outcome-blind prompt design.

issues.finding: A valid instrument does not imply available valid final-vector comparisons. This review deliberately has no outcome information.
issues.constraint: After terminal evidence exists, report actual eligible contrasts. If they are unavailable, leave the allocation-comparison question unresolved and report feasibility, arithmetic and assessable interpretation diagnostics only.

required_ko: 분석 단위는 사전 지정한 다섯 사례의 첫 최종안이며, 산업행과 초안은 독립 표본으로 계산하지 않았다.
v4.9.4는 이전 파일럿 오류를 관찰한 뒤 지시문을 명확히 한 개발 실행이다. 이전 실행을 대체하거나 동일한 사전계획 반복으로 합산하지 않았다.
비중 합계와 인용 식별자 점검은 형식·산술 확인이며, 출처가 실제 주장을 뒷받침하는지와 설명이 비중에 연결되는지는 별도로 검토했다.
E와 L의 차이는 자료 제공 시점·노출 횟수·자체 초안과 대화 이력이 함께 달라지는 절차 비교이며, 순수한 앵커링 효과를 식별하지 않는다.
실패와 미시도 사례는 예정된 다섯 사례의 분모에 남겼으며, 계산 가능한 비교와 누락 사유를 따로 보고했다.
의미 평가는 불완전하게 조건을 가린 AI 보조 서술 코딩이며, 사람에 의한 타당화나 독립 평가자 신뢰도 검증을 의미하지 않는다.

conditional_ko.if_no_valid_pairs: 유효한 최종 배분 비교가 확보되지 않아 배분 차이에 관한 연구질문은 미해결로 남았다.
conditional_ko.if_observed_similarity: 이 사례에서 배분이 유사했다는 사실만으로 기관 근거가 소실되었다고 판단하지 않았다.
conditional_ko.if_observed_difference: 비중 차이만으로 자료 반영의 적절성을 판단하지 않고 출처 의미·명시된 이유·실제 숫자의 연결을 함께 확인했다.
conditional_ko.if_infrastructure_missing: 해당 비교는 실행 중단으로 관측되지 않았으며, 이를 모델의 자료 해석 실패로 분류하지 않았다.

prohibited_claims: Market-wide harmful homogenization or a causal shared-AI-adoption effect
Actual Fidelity/UBS private mandates, holdings or optimal numeric weights
Pure anchoring/memory, semantic-content or macro-context addition effects
Population effect, p-values, bootstrap confidence intervals, equivalence or repeated-run stability
Future/realized investment performance, profitability or causal investment losses
Full blinding, independent human validation or demonstrated bias reduction
A better workflow solely because it differs more from C, has larger between-source distance, or has fewer detectable claims
Current main readiness or current pilot success inferred from this design review

errors.reason: The design separates ordinary arithmetic/citation errors from input/instrument failure and preserves planned denominators. Legacy metadata and historical-state ambiguities are explicitly identified.

consistency.reason: Six controlling freeze refs and five prepared D0 hashes match; common inputs and intended D0 visibility agree. No output-dependent behavior or F0 completion is certified.

paper_topic.reason: The central observable chain remains source meaning, stated interpretation, supported choice and actual weight/change. Reporting constraints prevent drift toward format-only success, institution gold weights or investment-performance claims.
